test_key.note: test-only keypair; the private half is committed in up01-contract-vectors.ts and protects nothing

vectors.description: First publish onto an empty stable: control_revision starts at 1, empty control fields
Version upgrade inherits paused/revoked_versions byte-for-byte and increments control_revision
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: publish inherits paused and revoked_versions byte-for-byte

vectors.description: A lower version than current stable is rejected
new == current with identical artifact identity is idempotent: nothing is re-signed
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: publish of the same version is idempotent only for identical artifacts

vectors.description: new == current with a different artifact identity is a conflict
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: publish of the same version is idempotent only for identical artifacts

vectors.description: Publish whose expires_at would exceed the key's not_after is rejected before signing
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: every operation enforces the full key-window precondition

vectors.description: Publish before the key's not_before is rejected
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: every operation enforces the full key-window precondition

vectors.description: Renew skips (no write, no control_revision bump) while more than 60 days remain
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: renew skips above the 60-day threshold and applies at or below it

vectors.description: Renew at 59 days remaining: only published_at/expires_at/control_revision change
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: renew changes only the time fields and control_revision

vectors.description: Renew that would push expires_at beyond not_after is rejected (rotation required)
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: every operation enforces the full key-window precondition

vectors.description: Pause flips paused=true and increments control_revision
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: emergency pause/resume flip paused and reject no-ops

vectors.description: Resume flips paused=false and increments control_revision
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: emergency pause/resume flip paused and reject no-ops

vectors.description: Revoke appends to revoked_versions; version/artifacts stay immutable
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: emergency revoke appends and rejects duplicates

vectors.description: Revoking an already-revoked version is an empty operation
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: emergency revoke appends and rejects duplicates

vectors.description: Pausing an already-paused manifest is an empty operation
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: emergency pause/resume flip paused and reject no-ops

vectors.description: tag=v0.20.3 placeholder contract: URL and object key carry exactly one v prefix
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: artifact URLs and object keys never double the v prefix

vectors.description: A version component above u64::MAX must be rejected exactly like the Rust parser rejects it
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: version components carry u64 bounds and full integer precision

vectors.description: A version component above 2^53 keeps full integer precision (no float rounding) end to end
vectors.evidence: tests/unit/release-manifest-transitions.test.ts :: version components carry u64 bounds and full integer precision
